arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Paul Clement argued the government engaged in a bait-and-switch scheme.
He claimed the government must keep its word after inducing reliance.
He stated the government treats similar payment language as mandatory in other contexts.
Mr. Kneedler argued the Appropriations Clause is a central constitutional command.
